# Our lib template

It contains nothing but Our opinionated project structure for a PHP library.

## Installation

There's 2 options:

1. Via GitHub [create from template](https://github.com/projek-xyz/php-lib-template/generate) (recommended)
2. Via Composer `create-project`

   ```sh
   composer create-project projek-xyz/template
   ```
